name: Mountain Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from 1939/1971/1974/1976/1979/1980/1981/1982/1983/1987/1989/2003 MNRF transect surveys (years from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 33.5 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (96.5% of water cells at >=0.4). Cold-regime lake; lake trout and cisco in the ARA community. Secchi 6.5 m (ARA).
